site.heroDescription: Keep each day's plan, booking links, wishlist spots, and trip photos in one calm, beautiful page.

auth.title: Sign in to view the trip
auth.description: Use a Google account that is on the family allowlist.
auth.configMissing: Supabase is not configured; sign-in is unavailable.

hub.title: Pick or plan a trip
hub.description: Document the trip in progress, start planning the next one, or revisit past journeys.
hub.noCurrent: No trip is marked as current. Set one from planning below.
hub.noPlanning: No trips in planning yet. Enter a name to start.

sync.supabaseNotLoaded: Supabase client not loaded. Check the CDN script in index.html.

overall.title: Tap a day for details
overall.description: Each block uses the same muted earth-tone palette so everyone can tell days apart quickly.
overall.clearConfirm: Clear all day content? Dates and trip length stay; titles, summaries, cities, stays, and timelines will be emptied.
overall.summaryEmpty: No summary for this day yet.

orders.title: Hotels, cars & activities
orders.description: Add email confirmations or cloud file links. With Gmail, you can paste a search URL for bookings.
orders.name: Name
orders.empty: No booking links yet. Paste a Gmail search link, hotel confirmation, or cloud file.

wishlist.title: Places we want to go
wishlist.description: Anyone can add sights, restaurants, or rest stops, and mark whether they're on the schedule.
wishlist.empty: No wishlist spots yet. Everyone can add their own.

map.title: Trip map
map.description: Pin main stays, sights, or meet-up points. Add a Google Maps API key for an interactive map.
map.noApiKeyHelp: Paste your Google Maps Embed API key in trip-data.js under googleMapsApiKey to show an interactive map here.

photos.title: Photo wall
photos.empty: Upload trip photos here; this browser keeps previews locally.

panel.editHint: After saving, the overview and day detail will both update.
panel.dateAuto: Calculated from start date and trip length
panel.summaryPlaceholder: Main theme or reminders for the day
panel.timelineEmpty: No times or activities for this day yet.
panel.wishesEmpty: No wishlist spots for this day yet.
panel.bookingsNone: No booking links yet. Add hotels, cars, or activities in the Bookings section.
panel.bookingsNoDay: No bookings tagged Day {day}. Include "Day {day}" in the name, e.g. "Day {day} hotel confirmation".

sampleSummaries: Airport transfer, check-in, nearby walk, first dinner together.

Half-day activity, free afternoon for family photos and kids.
Last-minute shopping and buffer; confirm transport and flights.
